AutoDock Vina

Use CPU mode to run Vina:

ultidock example run d2-antipsychotics --mode cpu

Vina receives the prepared receptor/ligand and a box derived from the selected site. In the full Ultidock pipeline, AutoGrid remains part of receptor grid/site preparation even when Vina performs the pose search.

The generated configuration includes VINA_CPU, VINA_EXHAUSTIVENESS, VINA_NUM_MODES, and optional VINA_SEED. Set them on pipeline commands with --vina-cpu, --vina-exhaustiveness, --vina-num-modes, and --vina-seed. Defaults are 2 threads, exhaustiveness 8, up to 9 modes and no explicit seed. These are setup options: with --skip-setup, the existing generated configuration is reused. Keep the actual configuration with the run.

The output PDBQT contains MODEL blocks and REMARK VINA RESULT scores. Ultidock extracts the lowest-affinity model to a -best.pdbqt file and associates that file with its own model number and score. Other models remain available in the original output and database.

Vina’s RMSD lower/upper bounds describe differences from its reference/top pose within the output, not an independent comparison to a crystal ligand. A negative score is not proof of activity. See Scoring / ranking and the upstream Vina documentation.
